Cheapest way to InfoDialog (launcher):
  MainActivity              MainActivity.onCreate
  -> ViewsActivity          @navigation/views_graph
  -> ListFragment           ListFragment.onViewCreated
  -> DetailFragment         DetailFragment.onViewCreated
  -> InfoDialog
  ViewsActivity also from deeplink https://navapp.example/views: LinkActivity -> ViewsActivity
(N.Ns; ~push~>: only for a notification or a deep link; every way and the code of each step: --verbose)
